description: This file defines a React component for a CRUD interface page, including data fetching, modal dialogs for create/edit/delete, form validation, and role-based access control. It manages a list of items with filtering and action buttons, integrating external components and context hooks.

methods.name: defaultString
methods.description: Utility function to safely convert an unknown value to a string, defaulting to empty string if not a string.

methods.name: Section4CrudPage
methods.description: Main React component implementing a CRUD page with role-based access, data fetching, filtering, and modal dialogs for create/edit/delete operations.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches the list of items from the backend and updates state.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for creating a new item.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for editing an existing item.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission for creating or updating an item, including validation and error handling.

methods.name: openDelete
methods.description: Prepares and opens the delete confirmation modal for an item.

methods.name: onConfirmDelete
methods.description: Handles the actual deletion of an item with user feedback and reload.
